summary: Quantum eMotion Corp filed Form 6-K announcing the board appointment of Catherine Loubier as director, effective May 8, 2026. The board increased its size to six members, and she joined the Audit and Governance Committees. The appointment is routine, not abrupt, and no prior departure or forced change is described. The filing is a foreign private issuer report, equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K Item 5.02. As a standard board addition, this does not represent a special situation; management changes category is applied conservatively, but the event lacks the forced/abrupt nature typical of this category. What to watch: any subsequent changes in board composition or governance.
